t: Pro-torque handle with 3 grip zones for comfort and control. Sand-blasted tips provide increased traction on screws, reducing slipping and effort required. Black phosphate-coated for durability and corrosion protection. Torx screwdrivers have recesses in the tip, making them suitable for use on standard or tamper-proof security torx screws. Colour-coded handles with identification rings.
